hook.name: VortaHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for Vorta markets that gates trading via an owner-controlled enable flag and launch timestamp, applies a dynamic LP fee that decays linearly from a high launch fee to a base fee (anti-snipe), enforces an optional Merkle-proof allowlist during an early-access window, charges a protocol fee on each swap routed to a fee recipient, and maintains a per-pool TWAP oracle with daily checkpoints.
